# Q3 2024 Quarterly Report — INTERNAL DRAFT

**Prepared by:** Data Analytics Team
**Status:** Draft — Not for Distribution

---

## Executive Summary

This report summarises key performance metrics for Q3 2024. All figures are preliminary
and subject to audit review.

---

## 1. User Growth

Active user count grew from **100 users in Q2** to **400 users in Q3**, an increase of
300 users.

## 2. Customer Satisfaction

A survey of **20 customers** conducted in September 2024 found a satisfaction rate of
**95%** (19 out of 20 respondents rated the product as "satisfied" or "very satisfied").

## 3. Revenue Performance

Nominal revenue increased by **5% year-over-year**. Note: the annual inflation rate for
the period was **6%**, meaning real revenue declined by approximately 1%.

## 4. Competitive Positioning

We benchmarked our Net Promoter Score against **3 selected competitors** (CompA, CompB,
CompC). Our NPS of 62 ranked highest among these three.

## 5. Safety Record

Over the past **7 days** (September 24–30), there were **zero reported safety incidents**.
The 30-day rolling period included 2 minor incidents.

## 6. Operating Costs

Total operating costs for Q3 were **$4.2 million**, a reduction of 8% from Q2's
**$4.57 million**.

---

## Appendix: Methodology

All survey data collected via opt-in email survey. Competitor NPS data sourced from
publicly available reports (Q2 2024). Inflation data from BLS CPI-U index.
